_instructions: Setting descriptors for the configuration composer (see crates/modules/configuration/settings-catalog.json). Current values are always read live; descriptors hold no defaults.

settings.description: Private Control browsers that may run at once across all users; more sessions wait in a queue.
examples: allow 8 browsers at once on the server
limit Browser Control to 3 running browsers
let more chats use the browser at the same time

settings.description: Private Control browsers one user may run at once across their chat sessions; more wait in a queue.
examples: let each user run 2 browsers at once
allow a user more parallel browser chats

settings.description: Seconds an unused private browser stays open when nobody is waiting for one.
examples: keep the browser open longer between steps
free memory from unused browsers sooner

settings.description: Seconds an unused private browser stays open while another session is queued for one.
examples: hand a browser to a waiting chat after 20 seconds
make queued browser sessions wait less

settings.description: Seconds a Browser Control call waits in the queue for a free browser before it answers that the browser is busy.
examples: wait up to 5 minutes for a browser
give up on a busy browser sooner
let chats wait longer for a free browser
